summary: Iteration 4 verification of 4 new features + regression. Backend: 15/15 new tests pass (strict payloads, fix-from-builder, saved circuits CRUD, export-job files+download), plus updated iter3 assertion (download no longer pops job) — total 36/36 backend tests pass. Frontend: verified Save→v1 toast, second Save bumps to v2 (update, not duplicate), My Circuits menu lists items, load restores nodes/edges/name, trash deletes; verified Analyzer 'Apply fix & re-check' on CORS-fixable problem — toast 'Fix applied & re-checked · CORS not configured' shown, fault edge cleared to healthy, problem removed from Trace. Codegen preview validated via backend (files endpoint returns {filename, ai_files, files:[{path,content}]}; download still works after files fetch — job not popped).

minor.issue: Body {"foo":1} does not 422 as specified — MonitorConfigRequest.config has default_factory=dict so extra keys are ignored and empty config accepted; only a wrong-type body (e.g. config as list) yields 422. To meet the spec, mark config as required or set model_config extra='forbid'.

action_items: (minor) Make MonitorConfigRequest strict: either mark `config` required or add `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` so `{"foo":1}` yields 422 per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: EXPORT_JOBS remains in-memory — files+download now both persist across restart-only-safe. In multi-replica deployment, download URL may hit a different pod. Acceptable for single-node preview.
builder_service.fix_problem mutates the input graph dict in place (nodes list is aliased). Works because we re-persist via update_one, but pure-return semantics would be safer.

Frontend BuilderPage.getGraph loses node status/meta/subgraphs on save→reload roundtrip (only id/label/category/position preserved). If restoring an analyzed circuit's fault indicators is desired, extend the ExportNode schema.
ProblemsPanel: fix button appears only when both p.fixable && onFix are truthy — consistent with spec; ensure BuilderPage also wires onFix if fixes are ever surfaced there.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_circuit / TEST_ui_circuit saved circuits during CRUD tests; re-analyzed expressjs/express during fix test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration4.py covers: strict payloads (validate/export/export-job return 422 on malformed; monitor/config only 422 on wrong type — flagged as minor spec gap), Fix From Builder (fixable flag, /projects/{id}/fix with bad id → 404, fix removes problem & heals graph), Codegen preview backend (files endpoint returns path/content list, download does NOT pop job), Circuits CRUD (POST creates v1, PUT bumps version, listing hides graph, GET returns full, DELETE + 404). UI Playwright verified Save/My Circuits menu and Analyzer fix-<id> button end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — only 1 minor validation-strictness gap on /monitor/config.
